objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed paperlessly from creation and editing to release, distribution, archiving, versioning, revision, validity extension, invalidation, reactivation, translation and evaluation.

attributes.name: document_type_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, consecutive, 4-digit number per document type included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Title included in the document name by default.

attributes.name: reference
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: it_application
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: relevant_company
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: area_of_validity
attributes.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to Master data or other documents.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document with integrated TAG technology.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document with integrated TAG technology.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Metadata that can be printed in a document with integrated TAG technology.

attributes.name: reader
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign reader authorizations via a user group assignment.

attributes.name: author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and identify the registered author.

attributes.name: co_author
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign additional personal change rights.

attributes.name: reviewer
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and workflow participants for review.

attributes.name: releaser
attributes.description: Attribute used to assign personal authorizations and workflow participants for release.

attributes.name: translation
attributes.description: Attribute included in releaser assignment for release control.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version required to be in Released state before translation can be carried out.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which validity is calculated after release.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period used with Valid From to calculate Valid Until.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration after which archived documents are physically deleted.

objs.name: document_type
objs.description: Selected when creating a new document and used to define document templates, validity extension period and archive duration.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selectable when creating new document objects.

objs.name: information_object
objs.description: New object attached in the system when creating new documents or adding Additional Info or Attachment to a document.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File that can be uploaded to a pure object cover.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted representation of a saved document displayed on the web.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Data such as IT applications that documents can be linked with.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Entity with which documents already in the system can be automatically linked.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Document attachment added to a document that is not subject to the release cycle of the main document and does not have its own release cycle.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document added to a document, automatically released with the main document and subject to its own versioning.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Actor who can view, create, edit, review, release, translate, receive notifications, confirm acknowledgement or perform workflow tasks depending on assignment.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group used for assigning authorizations, distribution, reader access, archive access and role-related availability.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting content or version history, managed in the document cockpit.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task in a workflow process that participants complete, with users informed by e-mail notifications.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: email_notification
objs.description: Notification used to inform involved users, authors, creators, distribution recipients or acknowledgement recipients.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: Request created by the system 30 days before validity expires and linked to the document to be checked.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created for a document to process invalidation or declaration of Override.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created to reactivate invalidated documents.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List maintained for each document by assigning User Groups or persons for e-mail distribution or acknowledgement.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation requested from distribution recipients and documented without a signature.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: User and role-specific dashboard filled through distribution groups and used to list relevant documents.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Role-specific evaluation report available for documents in the system.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which a document can be specified as visible or not.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one of the document templates defined for a document type when creating a new object.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to a pure object cover.

evts.name: generate_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain standardized and customer-specific document metadata in property editing.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document before system-supported conversion to PDF.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current converted version on the web.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Assign participants in the release process via property editing.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add Additional Info to a document when attaching a new information object.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document when attaching a new information object.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release Additional Info directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish Additional Info directly via switches in the properties.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete Additional Info directly.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify Additional Info without creating a new version of the associated document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: start_approval_process
evts.description: Initiate the approval process after document creation, maintenance and definition of document control.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewers check the document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releasers complete the release step and finally release the document.

evts.name: reject_workflow_task
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants after the first rejection.

evts.name: notify_user
evts.description: Inform involved users by e-mail notifications about status, workflow tasks or other process events.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Workflow participants complete tasks with an electronic signature.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new version in editing status.

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Create a new document version due to revision, specified changes, planned Change proposals, or reactivation.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting content or version history.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents the editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change proposal so that it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: declare_additional_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity, delete the request for validity extension and update the document Valid Until date.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process when a revised new version is released or when suspension has been declared.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow after attachment of the request for AKS.

evts.name: process_request_for_aks
evts.description: Process the request for AKS through the configured Override workflow.

evts.name: invalidate_document
evts.description: Declare documents and their attachments invalid and archive them.

evts.name: revoke_authorization
evts.description: Revoke all rights except archive group rights after Override.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete archived documents after the archive period expires.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation and select the corresponding document.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start the workflow for a request for reactivation.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: reactivate_attachment
evts.description: Reactivate Attachments archived with the document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain distribution lists for a document by assigning User Groups or persons.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned User Groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request active acknowledgement by e-mail upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient actively confirms acknowledgement using a workflow-supported task without a signature.

evts.name: evaluate_document
evts.description: Use role-specific evaluation reports and searches for documents in the system.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translate released content or documents into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Check translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Release translated version with workflow support.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client for a local addition to a document.

evts.name: create_reference
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.

o2o.description: A document is created with selection of the corresponding document type.
One or more document templates can be defined for each document type.
A template can be selected when creating a new document object.
New documents are created by attachment of a new information object.
External files or documents can be uploaded to a pure object cover.
A saved document is converted to PDF and displayed on the web.
Documents can be linked with Master data.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with processes.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with organizational units.
Documents already in the system can be automatically linked with risks.
Documents can be linked with other documents or referenced by local documents.
A document can be supplemented with objects of the type Additional Info.
A document can be supplemented with Attachments.
Users can be assigned to User Groups.
User group assignments grant reader authorizations and distribution access for documents.
Users can be assigned as author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator or distribution recipient for a document.
A Change proposal clearly belongs to a document and is displayed in the document.
A request for validity extension is linked to the document to be checked.
A request for AKS is created for a selected document.
A corresponding document is selected for reactivation in a request for reactivation.
Distribution lists can be maintained for each document.
Distribution is maintained by assigning User Groups.
Distribution is maintained by assigning persons or directly assigned users.
Acknowledgements are requested and documented for document versions.
Signatures are documented in the system for each released version of a document.
Workflow participants complete their tasks with an electronic signature.
Users involved in workflows have workflow tasks.
E-mail notifications inform users involved in workflows and distribution.
Relevant documents are listed or assigned in user and role-specific dashboards.
Reports evaluate documents stored in the system.
For each document in a multi-client system, visible clients can be specified.

Workflow participants are assigned for the release process of the document.
Users are assigned as workflow participants.
Additional Info is added to the document.

A new information object is attached to add Additional Info.
An Attachment is added to the document.
The event adds an Attachment.
A new information object is attached to add an Attachment.
Additional Info is released directly via properties.
Additional Info is published directly via properties.

Additional Info is modified.

The Creator workflow step concerns the document.
The registered author signs.
The step is completed with a signature.
The document content is checked.

The document is released.
Releasers perform the release.
A workflow task is rejected during review or release.
Users are informed.
Notification is sent by e-mail.
Tasks are completed with an electronic signature.
The electronic signature is documented.
Workflow participants sign.
The released document is published.
The valid released document is revised.
A new version of the document is created.
A Change proposal is created.
The Change proposal is created for a document.
Employees with author rights create Change proposals.
The Change proposal is scheduled for implementation.
Scheduling creates a new document version.
The assigned Change proposal is edited.
The author documents the editing.
The Change proposal is completed.
The system creates the request.
The request is linked to the document to be checked.
The request is processed with workflow support.
The document validity is checked.
Releasers, author, co-authors or reviewers may participate depending on process.
The document remains valid and Valid Until is updated.

The acknowledgement request is sent by e-mail.
The acknowledgement is confirmed.

The translated version is released.

Visibility is specified for the document.

A new local document is created in the client.
The new document is created in the client.
